name: com.sgonzalezrozo.ui-scroller
description: Recycling (virtualized) scroll view for Unity uGUI: lists, grids and bento layouts of any length that reuse a few slots, with zero allocations while scrolling. Measured sizes, sections with headers, expandable slots, looping carousels, pull to refresh and paged loading.

samples.description: Scripts for a simple list of 10,000 recycled items.
Grid, bento (with sections), sections, expandable rows, a looping carousel and paging. Each builds its UI in code: add it to an empty scene and press Play. No TextMeshPro needed.
A pull-to-refresh indicator and an empty-state panel. Uses TextMeshPro.
